trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash
trello.desc: Fix the NullPointerException crash in the media picker callback occurring on Android 14 when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload. Steps to reproduce: Start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, then return to the app. Target to have this fixed and verified by Wednesday to allow QA ample time for testing before the mobile release on August 20.

trello.name: Confirm Android crash fix on test devices
trello.desc: Once Marcus lands the fix for the Android photo upload crash, confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices. Add this validation to the regression run to ensure it is accounted for in testing.

trello.name: Develop offline mode for notes list - Backend
trello.desc: Create a backend sync API where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Implement a last-write-wins conflict resolution. This should be completed within the sprint to satisfy the enterprise customers' promises.

trello.name: Develop offline mode for notes list - Client
trello.desc: Implement the client-side feature for offline mode by using a local cache in Room, queuing writes while offline, and replaying them when connectivity is restored. Acceptance criteria include the ability to open the app in airplane mode, access and edit notes, and ensure data reconciliation upon reconnection with no data loss. Ensure these criteria are described in the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Complete the migration of CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Finalize the test and release pipelines, maintain the nightly build schedule, and run both systems in parallel for a week. Do not turn off Jenkins until the parallel week shows no issues.

trello.name: Add rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: To prevent performance degradation due to misbehaving scripts, implement a per-user rate limit of 100 requests per minute on the search endpoint, returning HTTP 429 status with a Retry-After header when exceeded. Include a metrics counter to monitor usage and identify heavy users.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Revise the privacy policy screen to meet GDPR compliance by making consent opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, eliminating any pre-checked boxes. This revision is mandatory for the August 20 EU launch and considered a launch blocker.

trello.name: Develop automated tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Create and implement regression tests for the payments flow including purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths. Integrate these tests into the CI pipeline within the new GitHub Actions setup to prevent future release issues.
